newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Foreign funds hold most China Development shares.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds hold most China Development shares.

text.p: China Development Corp, Taiwan's leading venture capital and investment firm, said on Wednesday that foreign funds have replaced the ruling Nationalist Party as its biggest shareholders.

"In July, foreign funds, which held more than seven percent of our stake, replaced the Nationalist Party, which had around six percent, as China Development's biggest shareholders," Vice President Fang Feng-shan told Reuters.
Fang said the Nationalists once held more than 12 percent of China Development, but had gradually reduced its ownership in recent years.
China Development's chairman, Liu Tai-ying, doubles as chairman of the ruling party's business management committee.
The firm had said it planned to convert itself into an industrial bank.
The Nationalist Party, one of the world's richest with T$85 billion (US$3 billion) in assets, is among Taiwan's leading investors through its seven holding companies.
